svg.aria-label: Two measures of a migration's progress over six months. The count of call sites found in the code falls to zero and the migration is declared complete. The count of requests actually served by the old path falls much more slowly and is still above zero at the same moment, because some callers build the path from configuration, another service is still on the old endpoint, and a nightly job was never grepped.
svg.text: USAGE OF THE OLD SYSTEM, COUNTED TWO WAYS
